Title: 492381-2026: France – Technical consultancy and design consultancy – MARSANNAY LA COTE - Rehabilitation of a sports gymnasium (Gymnase Enselme)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Renovation and extension of a sports gymnasium – sports buildings and large-span structures are generally very relevant for sbp, and here structural/technical consultancy services are explicitly tendered. The location in France slightly reduces the priority compared with DACH projects.
titel: Marsannay-la-Côte – Renovation of a sports gymnasium (Gymnase Enselme)
kurzbeschreibung: Comprehensive modernization of the Gymnase Enselme in Marsannay-la-Côte with partial demolition, functional new construction and extensions to improve sports use, accessibility, user comfort and energy efficiency.

relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Sports building (gymnasium) generally within sbp’s focus
- Project is renovation/partial new build, presumably a medium-sized municipal building
- Located in France, without explicit mention of complex structural engineering requirements

naechste_schritte: Optional: Contact Bureau Face B (administration@bureaufaceb.fr) to introduce sbp for structural design or specialist consultancy for sports buildings; if interested, offer references for long-span sports roofs and refurbishments.
notes: CPV 71310000 and 71240000 indicate combined architectural and engineering services; structural design is not explicitly mentioned, but could be part of the contract awarded to Bureau Face B. The project focuses on energy refurbishment, accessibility and functional reorganization of an existing gymnasium.
